display_name: Declarative Photorealistic 360° Three.js Worlds (Spatial Compiler + Optical Realism Engine)
title: Declarative Photorealistic 360° Three.js Worlds (Spatial Compiler + Optical Realism Engine)
short_summary: Build ultra-photorealistic, 360° Actor-Ready Three.js 3D worlds and environments by combining a fast ( 5 ms) declarative spatial constraint solver & sightline auto-repair engine (HeliosDSL SG0–SG4, G8–G9, AABB, and Ring-3 horizon closure gates) with Takram-grade volumetric cloud raymarching, Chappuis ozone sky, live sun-disk-free PMREM IBL, hybrid AI-generated stochastic PBR + analytical 3D erosion/derivative shaders, finite-depth dispersive planar-mirror water, and an 8-view 360° VLM realism climb.
